$comment: OP-XY OS changelog items that matter to a MIDI/USB controller app, paraphrased in our own words from https://teenage.engineering/downloads/op-xy (read 2026-09-26). Not exhaustive for other areas. Behaviour flags are for firmware-aware logic: if device_os < version, assume the old behaviour.

items.summary: MTP transfers made more stable.
Several TRS MIDI bugs fixed.
Pitch-bend tuning added to system settings.
The 'external' engine/track type is renamed 'midi'; LFOs now work on MIDI-only tracks.
Pitch bend is forwarded to linked tracks; arpeggio notes are no longer sent to linked tracks.
The MIDI echo setting is now respected for linked notes.
Fixed USB MIDI occasionally stopping.
Files can be moved over MTP.
Clock-related system settings reworked.
Fixed data corruption with more than 4 GB of user data (known issue since 1.0.15).
WITHDRAWN (marked unavailable): files larger than 64 KB copied off the unit over MTP could be corrupted; backups made on 1.0.29 may be damaged. Fixed in 1.0.32.
MIDI clock in and out over BLE; incoming transport is relayed to other connected MIDI devices; incoming sync handling improved.
A crash triggered by certain SysEx messages was fixed (older firmware may crash on unexpected SysEx).
TRS MIDI out no longer stops after unplugging/replugging.
Channel choice added when sampling from line-in and USB audio.
More characters allowed in MTP file names.
MTP export corruption from 1.0.29 fixed.
Holding COM shows battery status.
A mute popup appears when a muted MIDI track sends CC.
Fixed a crash caused by repeated project-load requests sent via MIDI CC (so a CC can request a project load; rate-limit such requests).
MIDI clock lag over TRS fixed.
USB hub support improved.
TRS MIDI clock timing fix.
CC values of external/MIDI patches are saved properly and excluded from scrambling.
MTP mode exits faster; folders can no longer be moved between root folders; empty folders deletable.
Miscellaneous USB fixes.
MIDI out no longer stops after MIDI clock arrives on the same port.
Filtered-out pitch bend is no longer recorded.
Synth parameters survive M1-browsing to the MIDI engine and back; better defaults when selecting the MIDI engine.
New MIDI command for delayed scene switching (details in the online guide).
Projects could not be saved above 4 GB due to a wrong disk-usage check; fixed.
A MIDI track can act as the duck-LFO source.
Patterns per track raised from 9 to 16; project templates; deeper user folder structures.
MIDI monitor added to the system menu (useful for verifying what our app sends).
COM device list and device popup reworked.
MTP more robust and faster; UTF-8 file names.
MIDI engine fixes: program-change p-locks work; scrambling no longer biases the first CC low; no mute popup for inactive MIDI tracks.
BLE advertising reliability fix.
New sustain-pedal behaviour (holds notes until pedal up).
The audio-only USB interface mode no longer shows as disconnected.
Notes are sent on TRS MIDI reliably while clocked from incoming TRS MIDI.
Stopping the hold player now sends a normal note-off with release.
Unit sometimes failed to start while connected to USB; fixed.
Arpeggio no longer changes the MIDI engine's parameter.
Fixed: parameter locks could not be added to empty steps.
